Safe 0x5904a70316eb658a2fd6d41d723e7b592ffda504 on Ethereum Mainnet, nonce 27, under Charter bafkreigg6ajqdb52kb644wcxegurt7r6jlclru4mjy3lwxkbh6avm3vgre. Disputed rule: R-4.6. The transaction delegatecalls MultiSendCallOnly 1.3.0 to make 7 ERC-20 transfers to 0x073997396b83b8ca325777bc08e4b65c65b4a190, which the Safe already sent 73 transfers of the same tokens through the same MultiSendCallOnly at nonces 25 and 26. The insecure vote cited R-4.6 without initially naming a target or source; the Sentinel subsequently clarified that its AML data labelled the UNI token contract (0x1f9840a85d5af5bf1d1762f925bdaddc4201f984) “USDT Blocked,” triggering an insecure verdict, and acknowledged this as a false positive because that label alone does not establish that the contract is malicious or compromised. The Council finds that the reported USDT blocklist label does not establish that the UNI token contract is malicious or compromised under R-4.6 and therefore rules the transaction secure with respect to the disputed rule. No precedent; novel R-4.6 fact pattern (§ 5.1).
